name: Ningbo Yongxin Optics Co.,Ltd
summary: Ningbo Yongxin Optics Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of optical microscopes, optical component assemblies, and other optical products in China and internationally. The company offers optical instruments and components; and biological microscopes and industrial microscopes, barcode scanner lenses and modules, planar optical components, professional imaging optical lenses, and lenses for use in optical and electronic products, such as bar-code scanners, motion optics, automotive driving, high-end cameras, HD projection, teaching, life sciences, and semiconductors, etc. It sells its products under the NOVEL, NEXCOPE, and Jiangnan brands.
